description: jarvi v1: website and landing-page prompts, design systems and design skills for AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, v0-style builders), found 2026-10-28 by GitHub and web search; every repo shallow-cloned and counted, none is in the harvest graphs v1-v9. Ids start at J01. Run `node server/jarvi/cli.js --v1`; data in jarvi/data, library in library/jarvi/v1, site store site/content/versions/jarvi-v1.

nodes.name: Brand design systems as DESIGN.md (VoltAgent, Japanese and Chinese collections)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted DESIGN.md files: VoltAgent 83 (one per well-known brand, MIT), kzhrknt Japanese-site systems ~595 (MIT, Japanese), fchangjun ~75 (Chinese, no licence file: preview plus link). A DESIGN.md is the file an AI agent reads to build UI in a brand's design language: colours, type, spacing, components. HU-UH/awesome-design-md is a Chinese translation of VoltAgent's set and is left out.

nodes.name: Website build prompts (landing pages, business sites, anti-slop briefs)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: KingLeoJr 'vibe coding' builder prompts per site type (templates/<type>/README.md, ~35), mah-claude 12 art-directed website build prompts. Both MIT.

nodes.name: Website design and landing-page skills
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted SKILL.md: bergside 67 design styles, LiamClarke1 6 (no licence file), JoshPearre 1, jiji262 1, MADEVAL 1, nroadley 1, adamholter 2, mah-claude 1, yzfly 1.
